history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: The essential of pride is in the aspect of the eyes — as it is written: "haughtiness of eyes" [Proverbs 6:17]. And one who shatters his pride and nullifies himself in the ultimate nullification — through this he merits to look upward with his eyes — to behold the pleasantness of G-d [lachazos b'no'am Hashem]. For it is impossible to ascend from level to level and to look upward as is fitting in perfection — except through the ultimate nullification.

segments.he:
ב.
אסור חמור מאד לאכל ולשתות קדם התפלה, כמבאר בזהר הקדוש (לא כמצוי עתה, בעוונותינו הרבים, שמקלין בזה, בפרט בשתית קאווע קדם התפלה) וכמה צדיקים נזהרו, שלא לשתות אפלו מים קדם התפלה, אף על פי שמותר מדינא, ועל ידי זה שאין אוכלין קדם התפלה, על ידי זה ממשיכין בחינת התקון שנמשך על ידי תענית, כי גם זה הוא בחינת תענית שעות, ועל ידי זה נשלם הדבור ומוציאין אותו ממצר הגרון, וזוכין לדבר דבורים שלמים לפני השם יתברך בתפלתו, ועל ידי זה נשלמת האמונה, שהיא בעצמה בחינת התפלה, כידוע. גם על ידי זה זוכין להתחיל לעסק בעבודת השם בכל בקר מחדש בבחינת: חדשים לבקרים. (שם, אות ה):
segments.en:
2.
It is a very severe prohibition to eat and drink before prayer — as explained in the holy Zohar. (Not as is common now, in our many sins, where people are lenient in this, especially regarding drinking coffee before prayer.) And many Tzaddikim were careful not to drink even water before prayer — even though it is technically permitted according to strict law. And through not eating before prayer — through this one draws the aspect of the repair drawn through a fast [ta'anis]. For this is also the aspect of a fast of hours [ta'anis sha'os]. And through this the speech is perfected — and one brings it out from the narrow passage of the throat. And one merits to speak complete words before G-d, blessed be He, in his prayer. And through this the faith is completed — which is itself the aspect of prayer, as is known. Also through this one merits to begin each morning anew in the service of G-d — in the aspect of: "They are renewed each morning".

(ibid., item 5).

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: Our Sages of blessed memory said: "The beams of a person's house, his rafters, and the stones of his house testify against him at the time of judgment." And seemingly this is wondrous — and if so, if someone committed a transgression, G-d forbid, outside or in a field where there are no walls [mechitzos] — who testifies against him? But in truth the essential witnesses are the aspect of the walls [mechitzos] of the house — both in the physical and in the spiritual. For all transgressions and all desires come through the blemish of the eyes — through going after one's eyes. Especially the desire for licentiousness — whose root is specifically through the sight — [sight] — of the eyes. As it is written: "And you shall not go astray after your hearts and after your eyes, etc." [Numbers 15:39] — as our Sages of blessed memory expounded. And the essential [blemish] is through the sight of the eyes of the thought [ainei hamachshavah] — for in whatever a person looks with his thought — whether for good or for the reverse — this is also called sight.

segments.he:
ג.
על ידי העוונות גורמין, חס ושלום, שנתערב ונחלף רוח האדם ברוח הבהמה, שזה בחינת החלוף שנחלף הבן מלך בבן העבד, וזה סוד כל הקרבנות כולם, לברר רוח האדם מרוח הבהמה, וכל אחד כפי מה שמערב על ידי עוונותיו רוח האדם ברוח הבהמה - כשאינו זוכה לתקן בחייו, חס ושלום, אזי הוא צריך לקבל ענשו להיות נע ונד בתוך כף הקלע ולבקש הניצוצות ורוח האדם שאבד והפיל בתוך רוח הבהמה, עד שמקבל ענשו בשלמות, ואז יתתקן, כי הענש הוא בשביל בשביל תקון. ועל ידי שאומרין פרשת הקרבנות ופרק איזהו מקומן וכו', נחשב כאלו הקריב קרבנות באלו המקומות, ועל ידי זה זוכה לברר כל בחינת רוח האדם מרוח הבהמה מכל המקומות שנפלו שנפלו לשם, ומתקנין ומעלין אותן משם וזה בחינת פסוקי דזמרה שאומרין אחר כך, כי עקר ברור רוח האדם מרוח הבהמה הוא על ידי נגון, שזה בחינת כהנים בעבודתם ולויים בדוכנם. (הלכות ברכות השחר, הלכה ג', אות כז כח):
segments.en:
3.
Through sins, one causes, G-d forbid, the spirit of a person [ru'ach ho'odom] to become mingled with and exchanged for the spirit of an animal [ru'ach habeheimah]. This is the aspect of the exchange — that the king's son was exchanged with the servant's son. And this is the secret of all the sacrifices [korbanos] — to extract the human spirit from the animal spirit. And each person — commensurate with how much he has mingled the human spirit with the animal spirit through his sins — when he does not merit to repair this during his lifetime, G-d forbid — then he must receive his punishment to be cast about within the hollow of a sling [kaf hakela] and to seek the sparks and the human spirit that he lost and cast into the animal spirit — until he receives his full punishment. And then he will be repaired. For the punishment is for the sake of — for the sake of — repair.

And through reciting the Torah portion of the sacrifices and the chapter Eizehu Mekoman, etc. — it is considered as if he offered sacrifices in those places. And through this he merits to extract the entire aspect of the human spirit from the animal spirit from all the places where they fell — [fell] — there. And to repair and elevate them from there. And this is the aspect of Pesukei d'Zimrah [the verses of song recited after this] — for the essential extraction of the human spirit from the animal spirit is through melody. Which is the aspect of the priests in their service and the Levites on their platform.

(Hilchos Bircas HaShachar, Halacha 3, items 27–28).

history.en: And a person must guard his eyes — physically and spiritually — not to look, G-d forbid, at anything that brings to improper thoughts. And in what he is necessarily compelled to see with his eyes — he must be very careful not to allow the eyes of his thought to look and gaze upon this, G-d forbid, until he comes to improper thoughts, G-d forbid. Rather, one must immediately erect the partition [mechitzah] of the brain against this desire. For the brain is an erected partition against this desire. And the choice is in the person's hand — to seize his thought — [his thought] — and to erect — [and to erect] — the partition of the brain and to be saved from this desire. For thought is in the person's hand to redirect it to the straight path. And as is brought elsewhere. And therefore the rafters and the stones of a person's house — which are the partitions — specifically testify against him. For even the physical partitions of a person's house — G-d created them all for the sake of guarding. For G-d created many partitions for the person before his eyes — so that he can guard his eyes from seeing evil, G-d forbid. For He created over the eye two partitions to cover it — which are the eyelashes and eyelids. As our Sages of blessed memory said. And likewise He created the partitions of the houses — within which a person must be hidden most of the time — in order to be guarded from the harm of seeing with the eyes that is outside.

segments.he:
ד.
כל הענין של הבן מלך שנחלף עם בן העבד, המבאר בספורי מעשיות, הוא כולל כל התורה כולה, וכל מה שעבר מתחלת חטא אדם הראשון, שנתגרש מגן עדן וכו', עד הגמר, שיבוא משיח צדקנו ותשוב המלוכה לבן המלך האמתי וכל עקר עבודת האדם בזה העולם הוא רק בענין זה, כמבאר בפנים, ועל זה סובב והולך סוד ברכת השחר וקרבנות ופסוקי דזמרה וקריאת שמע ושמונה עשרה, ושמונה עשרה, כמבאר בפנים. (שם, כז, כח, כט):
segments.en:
4.
The entire matter of the king's son who was exchanged with the servant's son — explained in the story-tales — encompasses the entire Torah entirely, and all that has passed from the beginning of the sin of Adam the first — who was expelled from the Garden of Eden, etc. — until the end: when our righteous Mashiach will come and the kingship will return to the true king's son. And all the essential service of a person in this world is only in this matter — as explained within. And this is what the secret of the morning blessings and the sacrifices and Pesukei d'Zimrah and the Kriyas Shma and the Shemoneh Esreh — and the Shemoneh Esreh — revolves around, as explained within.

(Hilchos Bircas HaShachar, Halacha 3, items 27–29.)

requiredNotes.text: שם refers to Hilchos Bircas HaShachar, Halacha 3, cited in the immediately preceding Prayer 3. Items 27–28 explain the prayer sequence and the true king’s son regaining kingship; item 29 continues the argument. The closing citation is to items 27, 28 and 29.
Both royal-son expressions are rendered “king’s son.” The repeated ושמונה עשרה, ושמונה עשרה (“and the Shemoneh Esreh — and the Shemoneh Esreh”) and the source’s “etc.” are retained.

anchors.text: the Shemoneh Esreh — and the Shemoneh Esreh

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: And the essential complete partitions — which are the essential guardianship above all guardianships — are the partitions of the brain [mechitzos hamoi'ach] as above. For even when sitting in the house — one must be careful not to blemish the partitions of the brain — not to come to improper thoughts, G-d forbid. And then — when one guards the partitions of the brain as is fitting — even when necessarily compelled to go out to the marketplace — he will be guarded there too through the partitions of the brain — which are partitions erected against this desire. And therefore one who blemished in some transgression, G-d forbid — which is only through the blemish of the partitions — therefore his rafters and the stones of his house — which are the partitions — testify against him. And therefore the Torah begins with the letter bais [beraishis] — for beraishis alludes to the three colors of the eye and the pupil, as is brought elsewhere. For the essential fulfillment of the Torah is through the guarding of the eyes — through the repair of the partitions — which are the aspect of bais [house] — the aspect of bais of beraishis.

segments.he:
ה.
עקר שמחתן של ישראל הוא על ידי אמונה בחינת: אנכי אשמח בהשם, וזה בחינת קריאת שמע, שהוא יסוד האמונה ומחמת שהשמחה הוא קומה שלמה עם רמ"ח איברים, על כן קורין אחר שמע ישראל שלש הפרשיות וכו', שהם רמ"ח תבות שיש בקריאת שמע, כמאמר רבותינו זכרונם לברכה. ועל ידי שמחה זוכין לגאולה בחינת: כי בשמחה תצאו, וזה בחינת ברכת גאולה שאחר קריאת שמע. וצריכין לסמך גאולה לתפלה, כי עקר שלמות עבודת התפלה - כשהוא בשמחה, בחינת: עבדו את השם בשמחה, והתפלה הוא בחינת דבקות בהשם יתברך, כידוע, שזהו תכלית השמחה לשמח בו יתברך ולהדבק בו בדבקות עצום ונפלא. ועקר בנין השמחה הוא על ידי עשרה מיני נגינה, ועל כן עקר התפלה הוא במנין עשרה, ועל כן אמרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה: 
כל תפלה שאין בה מתפלת פושעי ישראל וכו', כי זהו עקר שלמות השמחה - להפך כל מיני יגון ואנחה לשמחה, כדי שיהיה נעשה מהם מרכבה לקדושה, וזה בחינת חלבנה שבקטרת, כי קטרת הם גם כן בחינת שמחה, בחינת: קטרת ישמח לב, והחלבנה הוא בחינת היגון ואנחה, שנהפך גם כן לשמחה, ועל כן צריך כל אחד לזהר להתפלל בצבור דיקא, בכדי שאפלו אם יש בו אחיזת היגון ואנחה, יתהפך גם כן לשמחה על ידי קדושת רב הצבור, ועל כן התפלה היא רפואה לכל, כי כל הרפואות הם על ידי שמחה. (הלכות קריאת שמע, הלכה ב'):
segments.en:
5.
The essential joy of Israel is through faith — in the aspect of: "I will rejoice in G-d". And this is the aspect of the Kriyas Shma — which is the foundation of faith. And since joy is a complete stature [komah sheleimah] with 248 limbs — therefore, after Shema Yisroel one reads the three Torah portions, etc. — which contain 248 words in the Kriyas Shma, as our Sages of blessed memory said. And through joy one merits redemption — in the aspect of: "For in joy you shall go forth". And this is the aspect of the blessing of redemption [bircas ge'ulah] recited after the Kriyas Shma. And one must juxtapose the redemption to the prayer. For the essential perfection of the service of prayer is when it is in joy — in the aspect of: "Serve G-d in joy". And prayer is the aspect of attachment [devekus] to G-d, blessed be He, as is known — and this is the ultimate purpose of joy: to rejoice in Him, blessed be He, and to cling to Him in wondrous and extraordinary attachment.

And the essential construction of joy is through the ten types of melody. And therefore the essential prayer is with a quorum of ten [minyan]. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory said: "Any prayer that does not include prayer from the sinners of Israel, etc.". For this is the essential perfection of joy — to transform all kinds of sorrow and sighing into joy — so that they become a vehicle for holiness. And this is the aspect of the chelbenah [galbanum] in the incense [ketores]. For the incense is also the aspect of joy — in the aspect of: "incense gladdens the heart". And the chelbenah is the aspect of sorrow and sighing — which is also transformed into joy. And therefore every person must be careful to pray specifically with a congregation [tzibur] — so that even if he has some grip of sorrow and sighing — it too will be transformed into joy through the holiness of the large congregation. And therefore prayer is a healing for everything — for all healings come through joy.

(Hilchos Kriyas Shma, Halacha 2).

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: The essential deficiency of livelihood comes from the deficiency of counsel [chisaron ha'etzah]. For all livelihood comes easily when one knows to give oneself counsel as to how to conduct oneself and in what to earn. As it is written: "For it is He who gives you the power to make wealth" [Deuteronomy 8:18] — and the Targum [Onkelos] renders: "For it is He who gives you counsel to acquire wealth." For certainly at every time and at every moment there is some commerce and trade through which one could certainly earn. And if a person truly knew the counsel at every time — which commerce is needed now — certainly he would have livelihood and great wealth. And this is simple and clear.

segments.he:
ו.
כל המחשבות זרות וכל הבלבולים כולם הם בחינות: ערלת לב, חרפת לב, שבירת לב - כי הם מחרפין ומבזין ושוברין לבו של אדם וזהו עקר עבודת התפלה - לטהר ולזכך הלב מכל אהבות רעות ומכל התאוות והבלבולים, שהם בחינת חרפת לב, ערלת לב כנ"ל, על ידי הדבור של התפלה, שהוא בחינת צדיק מושל, שהוא בחינת הנקודה הקדושה, ששם שורה אור האהבה הקדושה, ועל כן בשעת התפלה מתגברין ביותר כל הבלבולים וכל המחשבות זרות שבלב, כדרך הנלחמים זה עם זה - כשבא צד אחד לבטל את חברו, אזי חברו רוצה להתגבר כנגדו, על כן באמת בשעת התפלה היא מלחמה גדולה, וצריך לזהר מאד לקשר הדבור של התפלה, שהוא בחינת הנקודה הנ"ל אל הלב, כדי לבטל חרפת לב הנ"ל. (הלכות נשיאת כפים, הלכה ה', אות ב):
segments.en:
6.
All the alien thoughts and all the confusions — all of them — are the aspects of: arlas lev [foreskin of the heart], cherpos lev [shame of the heart], sheviras lev [breaking of the heart] — for they shame and disgrace and break a person's heart. And this is the essential service of prayer — to purify and cleanse the heart from all evil loves and from all desires and confusions — which are the aspect of cherpos lev, arlas lev as above — through the speech of prayer. Which is the aspect of tzadik moshel [the Tzadik who rules] — which is the aspect of the holy point where the light of holy love dwells. And therefore at the time of prayer all the confusions and all the alien thoughts intensify — as is the way of those fighting one another: when one side comes to nullify the other — the other wishes to overpower against it. Therefore in truth at the time of prayer it is a great battle. And one must be very careful to bind the speech of prayer — which is the aspect of the point aforementioned — to the heart. In order to nullify the cherpos lev aforementioned.

(Hilchos Nesi'as Kapayim, Halacha 5, item 2).

origin.notice: English based on the supplied translation witness, incorporating source-bound corrections where needed.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: One who wishes to set his heart upon his ways — to look at his purpose and his eternal end — knows and understands that every single day one needs very many deep counsels to be saved from what one needs to be saved from, each according to his matters. Until he merits to pass the day in peace. For the yetzer hara overpowers a person every single day — and how many causes and adventures pass over a person every single day. And how many and how many deep counsels and great strategies one needs each day — that he merit to be saved from the cruel murderers and ambushers who stand over him every day: which are the yetzer hara and its forces. And one must every single day cry out abundantly from the depths — the very depths of the heart — [the heart] — in the aspect of: "From the depths I call You, G-d" [Psalms 130:1] — the aspect of: "Their heart cried out to G-d" [Lamentations 2:18]. Until one merits to draw deep counsels from the true Tzadik — which are the aspect of: "Deep waters — counsel in the heart of a man, and a man of understanding draws it up" [Proverbs 20:5]. So that he may merit to know to give himself counsel in every matter in a manner that will bring him true and eternal success.

segments.he:
ז.
בשעת המנחה, אז תקפא דדינא שלטא, שמשם כל המניעות מעבודת השם יתברך, ועל כן הזהירו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה ביותר, שלא לאחר תפלת המנחה, כמבאר במשנה: לא ישב אדם לפני הספר, וכו', מחמת שאז שכיחים המניעות ביותר, מחמת שאז הזמן שרב העולם טרודים במשא ומתן ופרנסתם, שמהם כל המניעות מעבודת השם יתברך, ואז צריך האדם להתגבר ביותר ברצונות חזקים וכסופין גדולים להשם יתברך, כדי שיזכר בהשם יתברך בתוך המשא ומתן, בתוך תקף המניעות, שזהו העקר וזה בחינת תפלת המנחה, כי התפלה היא עבודה שבלב, בחינת רצון, אך עקר התגברות הרצון צריכין בשעת מנחה, ועל כן הזהירו עליה רבותינו זכרונם לברכה ביותר, כי על ידי תפלת מנחה זוכין להמשיך ההמתקה של מנחה של שבת, שאז עקר הארת הרצון, רעוא דרעוין, כידוע, ומחמת שהרצון דקדושה הוא בחינת מנחת עני, על כן קראו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה לתפלה זאת בשם מנחה. (הלכות ברכות הריח, הלכה ה', אות ח):
segments.en:
7.
At the time of Minchah [the afternoon prayer] — then takfa d'dinah shalta [the force of strict judgment rules]. From which come all the obstacles from the service of G-d, blessed be He. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory warned especially not to delay the Minchah prayer — as is explained in the Mishnah: "A person should not sit before a barber, etc." Because the obstacles are most common then — since that is the time when most of the world is preoccupied with commerce and their livelihood. From which come all the obstacles from the service of G-d, blessed be He. And then a person must overpower himself more greatly with strong wills and great longings for G-d, blessed be He — in order to remember G-d, blessed be He, within the commerce, within the intensity of the obstacles. And this is the essential [meaning]. And this is the aspect of the Minchah prayer. For prayer is the service of the heart — the aspect of ratzon [will]. But the essential intensification of the will is needed specifically at the time of Minchah. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory warned about it especially. For through the Minchah prayer one merits to draw the sweetening of the Minchah of Shabbos [minchah shel Shabbos] — when the essential illumination of the will — ra'ava d'ra'avin [the will of all wills] — shines, as is known. And because the holy will is the aspect of the minchas ani [offering of the poor] — therefore our Sages of blessed memory called this prayer by the name Minchah.

(Hilchos Bircas HaReach, Halacha 5, item 8).

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: And for this King David, peace be upon him, cried out much: "How long shall I take counsel in my soul, etc.?" [Psalms 13:3]. And it is written: "With Your counsel You will guide me" [Psalms 73:24]. And it is written: "I will bless G-d who advises me, etc." [Psalms 16:7]. And for this our Sages of blessed memory ordained to pray each day: "And repair us with good counsel from before You."

segments.he:
ח.
בכל היום טרוד האדם בעסקים, במשא ומתן שלו, שהוא בחינת שנה תפלת המנחה הוא, שיזכר בהשם יתברך ויתעורר משנתו, שהוא בחינת המשא ומתן, ויפסיק להתפלל מנחה, ועל כן תפלת המנחה היא בחינת ראש השנה, שהוא בחינת התעוררות השנה, כי יצחק תקן תפלת המנחה, שזה בחינת ראש השנה, פחד יצחק, ועל כן אז דינא שריא ומחמת שעקר יניקת החיצונים הוא מבחינת דינים, על כן גזרו אז, שלא יתחיל לאכל ובמלאכה, כדי שלא ישכח להתפלל, ואמרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה: לעולם יהא אדם זהיר בתפלת המנחה, כי אז צריך זהירות יותר מחמת הנזכר לעיל. (הלכות תפלת המנחה, הלכה א'):
segments.en:
8.
All day a person is preoccupied with his affairs and commerce — which is the aspect of sleep [shenah]. The Minchah prayer is where he remembers G-d, blessed be He, and awakens from his sleep — which is the aspect of the commerce. And he pauses to pray Minchah. And therefore the Minchah prayer is the aspect of Rosh Hashanah — which is the aspect of awakening from sleep. For Yitzchak established the Minchah prayer — which is the aspect of Rosh Hashanah, the fear of Yitzchak [pachad Yitzchok]. And therefore at that time judgment prevails [dina sharya]. And since the essential nourishment of the outer forces comes from the aspect of judgments — therefore they decreed that one should not begin to eat or work [at that time] — so as not to forget to pray. And our Sages of blessed memory said: "A person must always be diligent in the Minchah prayer" — for then extra vigilance is needed for the reason mentioned above.

(Hilchos Tefillas HaMinchah, Halacha 1).

origin.notice: English based on the supplied translation witness, incorporating source-bound corrections where needed.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: The saying of our Sages of blessed memory is known: "In the path a person wishes to go — he is led along it." And from this come all the corrupted counsels — where it seems to him that they come from G-d — or that the Tzadik gave him this counsel. And in truth it all comes from himself. As it is written: "The folly of a person perverts his way, etc." [Proverbs 19:3]. For as one asks the Tzadik — so he answers. Therefore one who truly wishes to have consideration for himself must beg greatly in many supplications both G-d and the truly righteous Tzaddikim — that they place their heart fully upon what is being done with him and have compassion upon him in truth — in a manner that they give him a true counsel through which he will succeed in truth in prevailing in truth.

segments.he:
ט.
תפלת המנחה בכונה מסוגל לאמונה, ועל כן זכה אליהו לגלות אז האמונה הקדושה בעולם. (שם):
segments.en:
9.
The Minchah prayer with intention is a segula [-propitious means] for faith. And therefore Eliyahu merited to reveal the holy faith in the world at that time [minchah time].

(ibid.).

origin.notice: English based on the supplied translation witness, incorporating source-bound corrections where needed.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: Sometimes a person falls into so many doubts and divided counsels — that it is impossible for him in any way to know the truth as to how to conduct himself. And everything he strives to find as a complete counsel — his counsel is confused every single time. For now he has concluded in his mind with clear proofs that he must conduct himself in such and such a manner. And in the meanwhile a different view arises in his mind — until his first counsel is entirely overturned. And there arise in his mind views that he must conduct himself in the complete opposite of what he had previously thought. And this is the aspect of the divided counsels aforementioned. And sometimes the division of counsel intensifies so greatly — that he does not know in any way to decide the counsel to one side or the other.

segments.he:
י.
לפעמים האדם בקטנות כזה, עד שאינו יכול להרים קולו כלל, אוף על פי כן אל יתיאש את עצמו מתפלה ותחנונים ויקים: ושפלת מארץ תדברי.. ומעפר אמרתך תצפצף, שזה בחינת: ממעמקים קראתיך השם - מעמקי עמקים, פנימיות הלב, בחינת: צעק לבם אל השם, שזה בחינת תפלה בלחש, שתקנו חכמינו זכרונם לברכה בשביל קטנים שבקטנים וגם בשביל גדולים שבגדולים, כי הקטנים מאד, כל תפלתם היא בחינת תפלה בלחש כנ"ל, וכל תקונם - על ידי גדולי הצדיקים, שמתפללים גם כן בלחש, כי עולים בתפלתם עד בחינת עתיקא, ששם בחינת לחש, בחינת: חכם חרשים ונבון לחש, כי שם בחינת: סיג לחכמה - שתיקה, וזה בחינת: מה תצעק אלי - בעתיקא תליא מלתא, כמבאר בזהר הקדוש, הינו כי שם בעתיקא אין צעקה, רק שתיקה ולחש, וזה בחינת: השם ילחם לכם ואתם תחרישון, כי שם בשעת קטנות צריכין לצעק אל השם יתברך הרבה, אך לכל עת, כי צריכין להתחזק גם אז בתפלה ותחנונים להתפלל בלחש ומעמק הלב על כל פנים, כנזכר לעיל, ואחר כך זוכין להתפלל בקול רם, שזה בחינת תפלה בלחש ואחר כך מתפלל השליח צבור בקול רם. (שם הלכה ז', אות כז):
segments.en:
10.
Sometimes a person is in such smallness [katnus] that he cannot raise his voice at all. Even so, he must not despair of himself from prayer and supplication — and let him fulfill: "And you will be brought low from the earth you will speak… and from the dust your utterance will be chirped". Which is the aspect of: "From the depths I call You, G-d" — from depths of depths — the innermost of the heart — the aspect of: "Their heart cried out to G-d". Which is the aspect of the silent prayer [tefilah b'lochash] — which our Sages of blessed memory ordained for the smallest of the small. And also for the greatest of the great. For the very smallest — all their prayer is in the aspect of silent prayer as above. And their entire repair is through the great Tzaddikim — who also pray in a whisper [b'lochash]. For they ascend in their prayer to the aspect of Atikah [the Ancient One] — where the aspect of the whisper resides. The aspect of: "wise of hidden things and understanding of the whisper". For there is the aspect of: "a fence for wisdom is silence." And this is the aspect of: "Why do you cry out to Me?" — at Atikah the matter depends, as is explained in the holy Zohar. That is, for there at Atikah there is no crying out — only silence and a whisper. And this is the aspect of: "G-d will fight for you and you shall be silent". For there in the time of katnus — one must cry out to G-d, blessed be He, greatly. But everything has its time — for one must also strengthen himself even then in prayer and supplication — to pray in a whisper at least, from the depths of the heart — as mentioned above. And afterwards one merits to pray with a loud voice. Which is the aspect of the silent prayer — and afterwards the prayer leader [shali'ach tzibur] prays aloud.

(ibid., Halacha 7, item 27).

requiredNotes.text: אך לכל עת means “but everything has its time”: the cited discussion explains that there are times when one cannot raise one’s voice and should instead persevere in whispered prayer from the depths of the heart. The supplied Hebrew is unchanged. The work is Afternoon Prayer, identified in preceding Prayer 8. The compiler cites Halacha 7, item 27; the matching local passage is explicitly item 57, corresponding to item 62 in the numbered API edition. Neither comparison number replaces the supplied citation.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: And when a person sees in himself that he has been lying in this darkness for a long time and does not know any counsel as to how to emerge from what he needs to emerge from — and his counsel is very divided, G-d forbid — then this itself is his remedy: that he cry out to G-d about this very thing itself — about having fallen so far that he does not know the complete counsel as to how to emerge from darkness to light. For certainly there is no despair in the world at all. And certainly even in his place there are counsels as to how to emerge from darkness to light, from bad to good. Only that through his sins they have been hidden from him — in the aspect of: "Who is this who darkens counsel with words, etc.?" [Job 38:2]. And therefore his remedy is: that he know at least the truth — that he has fallen so far and been distanced so far that he does not know any counsel. And let him cry out about this itself to G-d — that He show him the counsel and the path as to how to truly conduct himself. As King David, peace be upon him, cried out much about this — for in truth even the very great Tzaddikim of very high stature — even upon them there pass — [counsels] — divided counsels in their matters and in their conduct. And as is understood from what King David, peace be upon him, cried out: "How long shall I take counsel in my soul, etc.?" — from which it is understood that greatly divided counsels passed over him. How much more so and certainly those of lower worth — how much more so those caught in the prison of desires and improper thoughts, etc. etc., G-d protect us — who must know and believe that certainly in every place they are, there is a counsel and a strategy as to how to emerge and return from there. Only they do not know the counsel — and their counsel is always divided. And therefore their remedy is: that they know the truth — that they do not know any counsel — and pray about this much to G-d. And then they can merit that the descent be the ultimate purpose of the ascent, as explained in the inner teachings.

segments.he:
יא.
יעקב אבינו, עליו השלום, זכה בגדל קדושתו להוריד את עצמו לעמק הנפילות של כל ישראל בכלל ובפרט ושבכל דור ודור עד עקבות משיחא, ועל כן תקן תפלת ערבית, שהוא בעת החשך הגמור, כי הוא מאיר בלב ישראל, שאפלו בתכלית החשך הגמור צריכין להתחזק גום כן לעסק בתפלה, כי לית רעותא טבא דאתאבד וזה תקן בעת שזכה לפגע במקום ההוא, שהוא מקום בית המקדש, ושם זכה להשיג בשלמות עצם מעלת האתערותא דלתתא, שאפלו התעוררות כל דהו, מאיזה בחינה ומדרגה שהוא אינו נאבד לעולם, כי הצדיק האמת בחינת יעקב משגיח על זה ומקבץ ומאסף הכל ובונה מזה בנינים נפלאים, כמבאר כל זה בפנים, על כן תקן תפלת ערבית, שאפלו בחשכת לילה ואפלה ממש יתעורר האדם להתפלל ולצעק אליו יתברך בבחינת: מבטן שאול שועתי, כי גם צעקה מהשאול תחתית אינו נאבד לעולם. (שם אות פב, פט):
segments.en:
11.
Yaakov our Father, peace be upon him, through the greatness of his holiness, merited to lower himself to the very depth of the falls of all of Israel — in the general and the particular — and of every generation until the very footsteps of the Mashiach. And therefore he established the evening prayer [arvis] — which is at the time of complete darkness. For he illuminates the heart of Israel: that even in the utmost complete darkness one must also strengthen himself to engage in prayer. For lais re'usa tava d'is'avad [no good intention is ever lost]. And this he established at the time he merited to encounter the place — which is the place of the Temple. And there he merited to fully attain the very essence of the virtue of the awakening from below [is'arusa d'lisata]: that even any small awakening whatsoever — from whatever aspect and level it is — is never lost forever. For the true Tzadik — in the aspect of Yaakov — watches over this and gathers and collects everything and builds from it wondrous edifices. As all of this is explained in the inner teachings. And therefore he established the evening prayer — that even in the darkness of the night and actual gloom a person should awaken to pray and cry out to Him, blessed be He — in the aspect of: "From the belly of She'ol I cried out". For even a cry from the lowest depths is never lost forever.

(ibid., items 82, 89).

history.en: One must banish sleep from his eyes and his eyelids — to wander and seek and multiply prayer and supplication, that he merit to find the Tzadik who can heal him and bring within him the attainment of G-dliness, and rescue his soul from destruction. And for this one must break the sleep and rise at midnight and weep and cry out greatly over the destruction of the Temple and over the passing of the Tzaddikim — which is twice as hard as the destruction of the Temple. Until he merits even now to find the true — [true] — rebbe and leader, who can bring within him the knowledge of His blessed G-dliness. Through which all his lacks will be filled and all afflictions nullified and everything repaired.

segments.he:
יב.
באמת כל מה שהשם יתברך עושה עם האדם, הכל הוא לטובתו, כמו שאמרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה, שצריך האדם לומר: כל מה דעבדין מן שמיא - לטב עבדין, ואם כן, לכאורה, קשה למה צונו השם יתברך להתפלל על הצרה, רחמנא לצלן, הלא כל היסורים והצרות, חס ושלום, הם טובות גדולות באמת לזכותו על ידם לחיים נצחיים, אך באמת בודאי מה שהשם יתברך עושה להאדם, הכל לטובה, ואף על פי כן האדם צריך להתפלל ולבקש מהשם יתברך לצאת מהצרה לרוחה, כי עקר בריאת העולם היה בשביל האדם הבעל בחירה, שיהיה הכל נמסר ביד האדם, הינו שהאדם דיקא יעשה כלים וצנורות להמשיך שפעו וחסדו יתברך למטה, ובלא תקוני הכלים, הנעשים על ידי האדם, אין שפע החסד יכול לירד למטה, כי אם ירד החסד קדם תקוני הכלים, אז יהיה בבחינת: רבוי השמן גורם כבוי הנר, ואזי החסד נתהפך לדין קשה, חס ושלום. ועקר תקון הכלים הוא על ידי תורה ותפלה, והעקר על ידי התפלה, ועל כן קדם שמתפלל האדם, בודאי הוא טובה גדולה כל מה שבא על האדם, אפלו יסורין, חס ושלום, כי הכל - לטובתו, כי לפי מעשיו אין יכול לירד לו שום שפע וחיות כי אם על ידי זה, וגם זה בחסד גדול, כי אם היו משפיעין לו רק חסד בלא דין כלל, היה חס ושלום, בבחינת רבוי האור, שמזיק יותר, על כן עקר התקון - על ידי התפלה, כי על ידי התפלה ממתיק דינים ומתקן כלים באפן שיוכל לקבל שפע חסדו יתברך בלא היסורים, רק על ידי תקוני הכלים שתקן על ידי התפלה, ועל כן עקר תקון התפלה הוא על ידי שמסתכלין על התכלית וכוללין כל התפלה באחד, ששם כולו טוב, וכמבאר בפנים, כי בלא זה אין יכולין להתפלל כלל מחמת קושיא הנ"ל, וכמו שהקשו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה: וכי נותנין לתינוק מה שרוצה, כי מאחר שהשם יתברך יודע האמת, שהיסורין אלו מחסרון פרנסה וכיוצא הוא לטובתו הנצחית, ואיך ישמע השם יתברך תפלתו לתן לו מה שיבקש ויגרם לו על ידי זה רעה לנצח, חס ושלום וכעין מה שכתוב: יש עשר שמוש לבעליו לרעתו, וכמובא בזהר הקדוש: חיכת בהון בעותרא בהאי עלמא ולבתר קטילת לון, חס ושלום, על כן באמת עקר תקון התפלה הוא על ידי שמסתכלין על התכלית האמת באמת, ויודעים ומאמינים שהכל לטובה, ואז דיקא יכול להתפלל אחר כך על כל מה שצריך, כי אז יכול להמשיך תקונים מאור הרשימה של הבטול אל התכלית, שעל ידי זה יהיו נעשים כלים להמשיך בהם רב שפעו וחסדו יתברך בשלמות באין מחסור כל דבר: 
פרנסה ועשירות ובריאות, ובריאות, בני, חיי, מזוני, ואף על פי כן לא יבוא לו על ידי זה שום נזק והפסד, חס ושלום, בשום צד, לא בעולם הזה ולא בעולם הבא, רק הכל יהיה לטובה נצחית גם כן, מאחר שכבר תקן כלים כראוי לקבל בהם שפע החסד, ועל כן באמת אין אדם יודע להתפלל בשלמות, כי אם הצדיקים האמתיים, וכמו שאמרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה: מי שיש לו חולה בתוך ביתו, ילך אצל חכם ויבקש עליו רחמים ושאר בני אדם צריכים לקשר תפלתם לצדיקים הנ"ל, והם יעלו תפלתם כראוי, שימשיכו להם שפע מה שצריכין: בני, חיי ומזוני וכו', באפן שלא יזיק להם לנצח, חס ושלום, רק אדרבא, על ידי השפע דיקא יתתקנו וישובו אל השם, ועל כן באמת יש בענין זה של התפלה נפלאות ונסתרות הרבה, ועל כן באמת אסור להתעקש ולדחק עצמו על שום דבר בתפלתו, וכמבאר במקום אחר, כי אולי באמת אי אפשר למלאת בקשתו אפלו על ידי התפלה, כי יזיק לו יותר, חס ושלום, כשימלאו בקשתו, ואם ידחק ויתעקש מאד בתפלתו, יוכל להיות שיפעל אצל השם יתברך למלאת בקשתו, כי האדם יש לו כח גדול לפעל בתפלתו, אבל לא יהיה לו לטובה, חס ושלום, כי עדין לא זכה בתפלתו לתקן הכלי בשלמות, שצריך לקבלת השפע שהוא רוצה, נמצא, שכל זמן שאין מתפלל על צרכיו, אזי כל החסרונות שחסר לו הם לו לטובה גדולה, אך על ידי התפלה מתקן כלים כראוי, שעל ידי זה יוכל יוכל לקבל שפע החסד למלאת כל החסרונות שלא ולא יזיק לו כלל לנצח גם כן, וכל זה - על ידי שמסתכלין באמת אל התכלית, שכולו טוב כנ"ל, ועל כן באמת עקר התפלה צריך שתהיה באמת בשביל תכליתו הנצחי, וזה בחינת מה שמובא בספרים, שעקר התפלה צריכה שתהיה בשביל להשלים חסרון השכינה, כביכול, ועל כן אפלו התפלה שמתפלל על צרכיו הגשמיים, יתפלל שיתן לו השם יתברך כל צרכיו באפן שיצליח על ידי זה לנצח, וזה בחינת סדר התפלה שמונה עשרה, שסדרו לנו חכמינו זכרונם לברכה, ומתחילין תחלה בשבחו של מקום - בשלש הראשונות, ומזכירין בברכה ראשונה איך שהוא יתברך גומל חסדים טובים וכל מה שעושה הכל לטובה והוא מלך עוזר ומושיע ומגן ואחר כך בברכת מחיה המתים, כולל גם כן שאר ישועות ופרנסה ורפואה, וכולל אותן כמה פעמים עם ענין של תחית המתים, הינו שאנו משבחין ומודים להשם יתברך, שכל מה שעושה עמנו הוא לטובתנו הנצחית, שהוא בחינת תחית המתים, ורק בשביל זה הוא מצמיח לנו ישועות נפלאים בכל עת בגשמיות גם כן: בענין פרנסה ורפואה וכיוצא, הכל באפן שיצליח על ידי זה לנצח, גם אחר התחיה, וממילא מובן, שגם מה שלפעמים נתעכב השפע, חס ושלום, הכל הוא לטובתנו הנצחית אחר התחיה, כי הלא מאחר שהשם יתברך הוא טוב ומיטיב כל כך וכל יכול ועושה חסד עם כל העולם בכל עת, מכלכל חיים וכו', אם כן מאין בא זה שלפעמים נתעכב השפע, בודאי צריכין להאמין, שהוא רק בשביל טובה נצחית, ועל כן הזכיר שם בברכה זו כמה פעמים ענין תחית המתים בסמוך לענין פרנסה, כי בענין הפרנסה מתעוקם לב האדם ביותר וקשה לו בכל פעם על עכוב הפרנסה, על כן צריכין להזכירו בענין זה ביותר, שכל הפרנסה והכלכלה, שמכלכל השם יתברך את האדם - הכל הוא בשביל טובתו הנצחית אחר תחית המתים, ומחמת סבה זו עצמה מתעכב הפרנסה לפעמים בשביל טובתו הנצחית אחר כך אומרים קדושה וברכת אתה קדוש, שזהו בחינת עצם התכלית, שיזכו כל ישראל לאחר התחיה שיקדישו שמו יתברך בכלל כל הקדושים אשר יהללוך סלה ואחר שכבר סדרו שבחו של מקום והודיעו, שכל מה שעושה השם יתברך הכל לטובה, אחר כך מתפללין על צרכיו, וגם זה מתפללין תחלה העקר על התכלית: על דעת ותשובה וסליחת עון, ואחר כך מתפללין על צרכי הגוף, אבל כל כונתנו גם בזה רק בשביל התכלית הנצחי, כי אנו יודעים ומודים, שהשם יתברך כל יכול, וכל מה שעושה עמנו - הכל לטובה, רק אוף על פי כן רצונו יתברך, שנתפלל לפניו על צרכינו בכדי לעשות כלים לקבל השפע בשלמות, והעקר - רק בשביל התכלית הנצחי, ועל כן אנו אומרים קריאת שמע קדם התפלה, כי על ידי קריאת שמע אנו נכללין באחד, ואז דיקא יכולין להתפלל, כנזכר לעיל. (הלכות מילה, הלכה ה ', אות דף, ה, ז):
segments.en:
In truth — all that G-d, blessed be He, does with a person is all for his benefit. As our Sages of blessed memory said: a person must say: "All that is done from Heaven — is done for good". If so, seemingly it is difficult: why did G-d, blessed be He, command us to pray regarding the affliction, G-d protect us? For all the sufferings and afflictions, G-d forbid, are truly great goodnesses — to cause him to merit through them the life of eternity. But in truth — certainly all that G-d, blessed be He, does with a person is all for the good. And even so, a person must pray and beseech G-d, blessed be He, to emerge from the affliction to spaciousness. For the essential creation of the world was for the sake of the human being who has free will — that everything be delivered into the hands of the person. That is, the person specifically should make vessels and channels to draw down His bounty and kindness, blessed be He, below. And without the repair of the vessels — made by the person — the flow of kindness cannot descend below. For if the kindness were to descend before the repair of the vessels — it would be in the aspect of: "an abundance of oil causes the lamp to be extinguished." And then the kindness would be transformed into severe judgment, G-d forbid.

And the essential repair of the vessels is through Torah and prayer. And primarily through prayer. And therefore before a person prays — certainly everything that comes upon him is a great goodness, even sufferings, G-d forbid. For everything is for his benefit. For according to his deeds — no flow and vitality can descend to him except through this. And even this comes in great kindness. For if only kindness without any judgment at all were to flow to him — it would be, G-d forbid, in the aspect of an abundance of light that damages more. Therefore the essential repair is through prayer. For through prayer one sweetens the judgments and repairs vessels — in a manner that one can receive the flow of His blessed kindness without sufferings. Only through the repairs of the vessels that he repaired through prayer. And therefore the essential repair of prayer is through gazing at the purpose and including all the prayer in the One — where it is entirely good. As explained in the main text. For without this — one cannot pray at all because of the aforementioned difficulty. As our Sages of blessed memory posed: "But does one give a child whatever he wants?" For since G-d, blessed be He, knows the truth — that these sufferings from deficiency of livelihood and the like are for his eternal benefit — how will G-d, blessed be He, hear his prayer to give him what he asks and thereby cause him eternal harm, G-d forbid? As in what is written: "There is wealth kept for its owner to his detriment". And as is brought in the holy Zohar: "חיכת בהון בעותרא בהאי עלמא ולבתר קטילת לון" — "She toys with them through wealth in this world, and afterward kills them." G-d forbid.

And therefore in truth the essential repair of prayer is through gazing at the true purpose in truth — and knowing and believing that everything is for the good. And then specifically one can pray afterwards for all that he needs. For then he can draw repairs from the light of the impression of the nullification toward the purpose — through which vessels will be made to draw through them His blessed abundant bounty and kindness in perfection with no lack of anything: livelihood and wealth and health — and health — children, life, and sustenance. And even so — no harm and loss whatsoever will come to him through this, G-d forbid, in any direction — neither in this world nor in the World to Come. Rather, everything will be for eternal good as well. Since he has already repaired the vessels properly to receive through them the flow of kindness.

And therefore in truth no person knows how to pray in perfection — except the truly righteous Tzaddikim. As our Sages of blessed memory said: "One who has a sick person in his house — let him go to a sage and ask him to pray for mercy on the sick person's behalf." And other people must bind their prayer to the Tzaddikim aforementioned — and they will elevate their prayer as is proper — to draw for them the flow of what they need: children, life, and sustenance, etc. In a manner that it will not harm them eternally, G-d forbid. Rather, on the contrary — through the flow specifically they will be repaired and return to G-d.

And therefore in truth there are many wonders and hidden matters in this matter of prayer. And therefore in truth it is forbidden to be stubborn and to press oneself about anything in one's prayer — as is explained elsewhere. For perhaps in truth it is impossible to fulfill one's request even through prayer — as it may harm him more, G-d forbid, if his request is fulfilled. And if he presses and is very stubborn in his prayer — it could be that he will accomplish with G-d, blessed be He, the fulfillment of his request. For a person has great power to accomplish through his prayer. But it will not be for his benefit, G-d forbid. For he has not yet merited through his prayer to repair the vessel in perfection that is needed for receiving the flow that he wants. It is thus found: that as long as he is not praying for his needs — all the lacks he has are a great goodness for him. But through prayer he repairs vessels properly — through which he can — [can] — receive the flow of kindness to fill all the lacks — and it will not — [not] — harm him at all eternally either. And all of this — through gazing in truth at the purpose — which is entirely good as above.

And therefore in truth the essential prayer must truly be for one's eternal purpose. And this is the aspect of what is brought in the sacred books: that the essential prayer must be for the sake of making good the lack of the Shechinah, as it were. And therefore even the prayer one prays for one's physical needs — one should pray that G-d, blessed be He, give him all his needs in a manner that will bring him eternal success. And this is the aspect of the order of the Shemoneh Esreh that our Sages of blessed memory arranged for us. And we begin first with the praise of the Omnipresent — in the first three blessings. And in the first blessing we mention how He, blessed be He, bestows good kindnesses — and all that He does is entirely for the good. And He is the King, helper, savior, and shield. And afterwards in the blessing of "Who revives the dead" — one includes also other salvations and sustenance and healing. And one includes them many times together with the matter of the revival of the dead. That is, we praise and give thanks to G-d, blessed be He, that all that He does with us is for our eternal benefit — which is the aspect of the revival of the dead. And only for this does He cause wondrous salvations to sprout for us at all times also in the physical: in matters of sustenance and healing and the like. All in a manner that will bring eternal success — also after the Revival. And thus it is understood that also the fact that the flow is sometimes delayed, G-d forbid — all of it is for our eternal benefit after the Revival. For since G-d, blessed be He, is so good and so beneficent and so all-powerful — and does kindness with the entire world at all times — sustains the living, etc. — if so, from where does it come that sometimes the flow is delayed? Certainly one must believe that it is only for eternal benefit. And therefore there the blessing mentions the matter of the Revival of the Dead many times in close proximity to the matter of sustenance. For in the matter of sustenance, a person's heart becomes most distorted — and he finds the delay in livelihood difficult every time. And therefore one must especially be reminded in this matter — that all the sustenance and provision that G-d, blessed be He, provides for a person — all of it is for his eternal benefit after the Revival of the Dead. And for this very same reason the sustenance is sometimes delayed — for his eternal benefit.

And afterwards one says Kedushah and the blessing "You are holy" — which is the aspect of the very essence of the purpose: that all of Israel should merit after the Revival to sanctify His blessed Name together with all the holy ones who will praise You forever. And after having arranged the praise of the Omnipresent and proclaimed that all that G-d, blessed be He, does is entirely for the good — then one prays for his needs. And even here one first prays chiefly for the ultimate purpose: for knowledge and repentance and forgiveness of sin. And then one prays for the needs of the body. But all our intention even in this is only for the eternal purpose. For we know and acknowledge that G-d, blessed be He, is all-powerful — and all that He does with us is entirely for the good. Only even so it is His blessed will that we pray before Him for our needs — in order to make vessels to receive the flow in perfection. And the essential thing — only for the sake of the eternal purpose. And therefore we recite the Kriyas Shma before the prayer. For through the Kriyas Shma we are encompassed in the One. And then specifically one can pray — as mentioned above.

(Hilchos Milah, Halacha 5, items 4, 5, 7.)

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: The great Tzadik aforementioned — who engages in drawing close those who are distant, in whom the baal davar and his forces have seized with greatest force — descends in the very depth of his wisdom so far toward them, until it appears as if he is performing acts of youthfulness. For he speaks mundane conversation with them and eats and drinks with them — and sometimes even plays and jokes with them. And all his intention — to draw them close to G-d through this.

segments.he:
יג.
צריכין להתחזק מאד באמונה שלמה להאמין בעצמו, שיש לו כח לפעל כל דבר בתפלתו, כי יש כמה מיני חלישות הדעת בלב האדם בענין זה, כאשר יודע כל אחד בעצמו, ורב בני אדם נדמה להם, שאין להם כח לזה, ועל כן אינם מתחזקים בתפלה, ועל כן צריכין להתיגע ביגיעה ועבודה גדולה מאד לחזק את עצמו להתפלל בכונה. ועקר היגיעה היא בתחלה, דהינו בעת שמתחיל להתחזק להתפלל בכונה בבחינת כל התחלות קשות, כי אז עדין לא ראה שום פעולה על ידי תפלתו, אבל כשזוכה להתגבר בכל כחו להתפלל בכונה, עד שזוכה לפעל איזה דבר בתפלתו, כגון שהתפלל על איזה דבר ונענה, אז הוא מתחזק בזה להאמין גם בעצמו, שיש לו כח לפעל בתפלתו, מאחר שרואה, שכבר שמע השם יתברך גם תפלתו ונענה, ואז נעשה אצלו כלי שלמה לקבל השפע על ידי דבורי התפלה, כי עקר התהוות הכלי הוא על ידי האמונה, דהינו על ידי שמאמין גם בעצמו, שהשם יתברך שומע תפלתו. (הלכות נחלות, הלכה ד', אות ד):
segments.en:
13.
One must strengthen oneself greatly in complete faith — to believe in himself that he has the power to accomplish anything through his prayer. For there are many types of weakness of mind in a person's heart in this matter — as every person knows within himself. And the majority of people imagine that they have no power for this. And therefore they do not strengthen themselves in prayer. And therefore one must toil with very great toil and service to strengthen himself to pray with intention. And the essential toil is at the beginning — that is, at the time he begins to strengthen himself to pray with intention — in the aspect of: "all beginnings are difficult." For at that time he has not yet seen any action from his prayer. But when he merits to overpower himself with all his strength to pray with intention — until he merits to accomplish some thing through his prayer — such as he prayed about some matter and was answered — then he is strengthened in this to believe even in himself that he has the power to accomplish through his prayer. Since he sees that G-d, blessed be He, has already heard his prayer too and he was answered. And then a complete vessel is formed for him to receive the flow through the words of prayer. For the essential formation of the vessel is through faith — that is, through believing even in himself that G-d, blessed be He, hears his prayer.

(Hilchos Nachalos, Halacha 4, item 4).

origin.notice: English based on the supplied translation witness, incorporating source-bound corrections where needed.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: There is great virtue in being with the Tzadik at a time when there is a large gathering of many people of Israel with him. For certainly every single particular person is very, very far from the holiness of the Tzadik of the generation. And it is impossible to receive [illumination] from him except through the collective of Israel — through which his great illumination is drawn. And then every single particular person can also receive his illumination individually.

segments.he:
יד.
יש שני מיני קלפות, שמבלבלין דעת האדם מלהתחזק בתפלה, והם קלפות עשו וישמעאל, שזה בחינת קלפות הערלה והפריעה קלפת עשו עמלק הוא בחינת הערלה הגמורה, כי הוא כופר בעקר ואינו מודה בתפלה כלל ומטעה לב האדם לומר, שאין התפלה מועלת, חס ושלום, מאחר שמתארך הגלות כל כך, ובכל יום צועקים ואינם נושעים ועל ידי מצות מילה, שחותכין הערלה דחפיא על ברית, על ידי זה מבטלין קלפתו הרעה ונמשך בחינת תקון הברית, שעל ידי זה זוכין להתחזק בתפלה תמיד, כי עקר תקון התפלה הוא על ידי תקון הברית אבל עדין יש קלפה אחרת, בחינת קלפת עור הפריעה, שהוא בחינת קלפת ישמעאל, שמשם נמשך טעות אחר בלב האדם להתרשל בתפלה, חס ושלום, מחמת שנדמה לו, שכבר שמע השם יתברך בודאי את תפלתו, בפרט כשרואה איזה צמיחת קרן ישועה, שאז נדמה לו, שכבר נתקבלה תפלתו, והוא מתרשל להתפלל יותר, וזה נמשך מבחינת קלפת ישמעאל, שנקרא כן על שם: כי שמע השם אל עניך, ותרגומו: ארי קבל השם ית צלותיך, ובאמת אפלו כשאין רואין עדין שום ישועה, צריכין להאמין שאין שום תפלה לריק, חס ושלום, ולהתחזק בתפלה יותר, וכן להפך, אפלו כשרואין איזה ישועה, אסור לבטל ולהתרשל מתפלתו על ידי זה, רק צריכין לשמח בישועתו ולהיות מודה על העבר וצועק לעתיד לבוא, כי עדין אנו צריכין הרבה, ישועות מאד כל ימי חיינו, עד שנזכה לבוא למה שאנו צריכין לבוא, אשר בשביל זה באנו לעולם הזה, ואם יתרשל בתפלה על ידי שנדמה לו שכבר פעל בתפלתו הרבה, שזה נמשך מבחינת קלפת ישמעאל, בחינת קלפת הפריעה - על ידי זה, חס ושלום, נתעכב גמר ישועתו ויתארך גלותו, חס ושלום, ואז יחזר ויתעורר קלפת עשו עמלק, שהיא בחינת קלפת הערלה, ויטמטם לבו לגמרי מלהתחזק בתפלתו על ידי זה בעצמו שרואה, שזה כמה שצועק ואינו נענה עדין לזכות לישועה שלמה וזה בחינת: מל ולא פרע, כאלו לא מל, וזה בחינת: וישב מרדכי, ודרשו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה, ששב לשקו ולתעניתו, כי אף על פי שכבר ראה ישועות נפלאים כזאת, שהרכיבוהו על סוס המלך וקראו לפניו וכו', אוף על פי כן לא נתרשל על ידי זה מתפלתו וצעקתו וכן אצל אסתר כתיב: 
ותוסף אסתר ותדבר לפני המלך וכו', ותבך ותתחנן לו להעביר את רעת המן וכו', וזה מרמז על כלל כנסת ישראל, שהם בחינת אסתר, שאפלו כשרואין ישועות ונסים גדולים ונפלאים, שהסטרא אחרא בחינת המן עמלק כבר נפלה מאד, ותלו אותו אותו בניו על העץ אוף על פי כן אינם מסתפקים בזה, ועדין הם עומדים ומתפללים ובוכים ומתחננים לפניו יתברך, כבן המתחטא לפני אביו, להעביר את רעת המן, שהוא הסטרא אחרא, לגמרי, שיזכו להטהר ולהתקדש לגמרי, כי אף על פי שבודאי צריכין להודות הרבה על הישועות שכבר נעשו לו, אוף על פי כן עדין אנו צריכין להרבות בתפלה מאד, כי עדין אנו צריכין ישועות רבות כל ימי חיינו, על כן צריכין להתחזק להרבות בתפלה תמיד. (שם, אות כג, כד):
segments.en:
14.
There are two kinds of kelipos [husks] that confuse a person's mind from strengthening himself in prayer. They are the husks of Eisav and Yishmo'el — which are the husks of the orlah [foreskin] and the peri'ah [secondary membrane]. The husk of Eisav-Amalek is the aspect of the outright orlah — for he denies the very foundation and does not acknowledge prayer at all. And he misleads a person's heart to say that prayer accomplishes nothing, G-d forbid — since the exile drags on for so long and every day one cries out and is not saved. And through the commandment of circumcision [bris milah] — which cuts the orlah that covers the bris — through this his evil husk is nullified and the aspect of the repair of the bris is drawn. Through which one merits to always strengthen himself in prayer. For the essential repair of prayer is through the repair of the bris.

But there is still another husk — the husk of the skin of peri'ah — which is the aspect of the husk of Yishmo'el. From which a different error is drawn in a person's heart — to become lax in prayer, G-d forbid. Because it seems to him that G-d, blessed be He, has certainly already heard his prayer. Especially when he sees some sprouting of a ray of salvation — then it seems to him that his prayer has already been received. And he becomes lax about praying further. And this is drawn from the aspect of the husk of Yishmo'el — who is named thus from: "For G-d has heard your affliction" — and its Targum: "for G-d has received your prayer."

But in truth — even when one has not yet seen any salvation — one must believe that no prayer is in vain, G-d forbid. And to strengthen oneself in prayer even more. And likewise the reverse — even when one sees some salvation — it is forbidden to nullify and become lax in one's prayer because of this. Rather, one must rejoice in the salvation and give thanks for the past — and cry out for the future. For we still need many, very many salvations all the days of our lives — until we merit to come to what we need to come to — for which purpose we came into this world. And if one becomes lax in prayer because it seems to him that he has already accomplished much through his prayer — which is drawn from the aspect of the husk of Yishmo'el, the husk of peri'ah — through this, G-d forbid, the completion of his salvation is delayed and his exile is prolonged, G-d forbid. And then the husk of Eisav-Amalek — which is the husk of orlah — returns and arouses — and darkens his heart entirely from strengthening himself in his prayer through this very thing: that he sees that he has been crying out for so long and still is not answered with complete salvation.

And this is the aspect of: "one who was circumcised but did not perform peri'ah — it is as if he was not circumcised." And this is the aspect of: "And Mordechai returned" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: he returned to his sackcloth and his fast . For even though he had already seen such a wondrous salvation — that they had made him ride upon the king's horse and proclaimed before him, etc. — even so, he did not become lax through this in his prayer and his crying out. And likewise regarding Esther it is written: "And Esther spoke further before the king, etc. — and she wept and implored him to remove the evil of Haman, etc.". And this alludes to all of Kneses Yisroel [the Congregation of Israel] — who are the aspect of Esther. That even when they see great salvations and wondrous miracles — that the sitra achra in the aspect of Haman-Amalek has already fallen greatly, and they have hung him — him — [and] his sons on the tree — even so they are not satisfied with this and still stand and pray and weep and implore before Him, blessed be He — like a child who wheedles before his father — to remove the evil of Haman who is the sitra achra entirely. So that they merit to be purified and sanctified entirely.

For even though certainly one must give much thanks for the salvations that have already been done for him — even so, we still need to greatly multiply prayer. For we still need many salvations all the days of our lives. Therefore one must strengthen oneself to always greatly multiply prayer.

(ibid., items 23, 24).

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: That teshuvah is effective for all sins — this is only from the side of chesed [kindness]. And for the sin of wasting seed [hotzo'as zera l'vatolo] our Sages of blessed memory said that teshuvah is not effective for it — for such is fitting for it, as explained in the inner teachings. But in truth there is nothing that stands before teshuvah. Only the essential repair is through the Tzadik of the generation. For he can awaken and draw upon him new chesed — until this too will be repaired.

segments.he: ערך תפלין
segments.en: Tefillin

origin.notice: Editorial English rendering of the supplied Hebrew heading or closing text.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: In every generation there are many truly righteous Tzaddikim. But there is truth above truth — for certainly the level and stature of all Tzaddikim is not equal. And the greater the stature and level of the Tzaddikim — certainly his truth is greater and he extracts more. For the essential thing is truth. Until in every generation there is a true Tzadik who is the aspect of the point of truth among the Tzaddikim. Only because of the intensification of the substitutions and exchanges — through this it is very difficult to know where the truth is. For most of the time the baal davar provokes even the Tzaddikim themselves and introduces great controversy between them — to dispute this true Tzadik who is the aspect of the point of truth among the Tzaddikim. And it seems to them as if this specific Tzadik is the one who deviates, G-d forbid, from the path of truth.

segments.he:
א.
תפלין נכתבין על עור בהמה - זה בחינת בני אדם, שערומים בדעת כאדם ומשימין עצמן כבהמה, שצריכין לשום עצמו כבהמה לסלק דעתו לגמרי כאלו אין לו שום דעת כלל ולסמך רק על אמונה, ואזי נזדכך מחו על ידי זה ונפשט עקמימות שבלבו, כי כשרואה אדם, שיש לו עקמימות בלבו, בפרט כשיש לו, חס ושלום עקמימות הרבה בלבו, אזי הוא צריך לסלק דעתו לגמרי כאלו אין לו שום דעת כלל, וילך רק בתמימות ופשיטות לבד, ואזי זוכה אחר כך לדעת גדול מאד ולפשט עקמימות שבלבו, שכל זה בחינת תפלין. (הלכות תפלין, הלכה ד', אות ו):
segments.en:
1.
Tefillin are written on the skin of an animal [ohr beheimah] — this is the aspect of people who are shrewd in understanding like a human [adom] yet make themselves like an animal [beheimah]. That is, one must make himself like an animal — to set aside one's mind entirely, as if one has no mind at all — and rely only on faith. And then through this one's mind is clarified and the crookedness [akmimusin] in one's heart is straightened. For when a person sees that he has crookedness in his heart — especially when he has, G-d forbid, much crookedness in his heart — then he must set aside his mind entirely as if he has no mind at all — and go only in wholeness [temimus] and simplicity [peshitus] alone. And then he merits afterwards to very great knowledge [da'as] and to straighten out the crookedness in his heart. And all of this is the aspect of tefillin.

(Hilchos Tefillin, Halacha 4, item 6).

origin.notice: English based on the supplied translation witness, incorporating source-bound corrections where needed.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: And from this came the aspect of the controversy of the tribes against Yosef — until "as a slave was Yosef sold" [Psalms 105:17]. And through this the matter rolled on, and our ancestors descended to Egypt and were slaves there. And likewise the controversy of Shaul — who pursued David for no cause. And as we find in many, many generations. Especially in these generations in the footsteps of the Mashiach — when the accusation and the controversy intensified even among the Tzaddikim — until one does not know where the truth is. And therefore one must pray to G-d much about this as above.

segments.he:
ב.
אמרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה: בכל יום יצרו של אדם מתגבר עליו, ואלמלא הקדוש ברוך הוא עוזרו - לא היה יכול לו. בכל יום יצרו מתגבר עליו, זה נמשך מבחינת: 
בתחלה עלה במחשבה לברא את העולם במדת הדין, שזה הדין מתעורר בכל יום ורוצה, חס ושלום, לנהג העולם בבחינה זאת, ומשם מתעורר ומתגבר היצר הרע, שנמשך משם בכל יום ויום, כי עקר היצר הרע והסטרא אחרא נמשך מבחינת דינים, שנמשכין מתחלת הצמצום של חלל הפנוי, אך השם יתברך מרחם תכף ומקדים מדת הרחמים למדת הדין, כמאמר רבותינו זכרונם לברכה: ראה שאין העולם מתקים וכו', שזהו בחינת העזר והסיוע, שמסיע להאדם בכל יום לשבר את היצר הרע, שהוא ממדת הדין וזה בחינת תפלין דרש"י, שהחסדים קודמין לגבורות, וזה בחינת: הקדים מדת הרחמים ושתף למדת הדין, שזהו עקר ההנהגה והקיום של כל העולם, ועל כן עקר התפלין, שהכל מניחין, הם של רש"י כי זהו עקר הנהגת העולם וקיומו על ידי בחינה זו אבל יש צדיקים גדולים כל כך, שאין צריכין סיוע דלעלא, והשם יתברך מתנהג עמהם כמו בתחלת המחשבה, הינו במדת הדין, והם עומדים בכל הנסיונות והיסורין והצרות, הנמשכין ממדת הדין הנ"ל, ונשארים על עמדם, והם ממתיקין הדין בשרשו בתחלת המחשבה, כי מאמינים ויודעים, שהדינים והיסורים בעצמן הם טובות גדולות, ועל ידי זה באמת הם זוכים לעלות ולהכלל בתחלת המחשבה, שזה בחינת: כך עלה במחשבה, הנאמר על מיתת רבי עקיבא וזה בחינת תפלין דרבנו תם, שהם בחינת מחין גבוהין ביותר, ושם הגבורות קודמין לחסדים, שזה בחינת ההנהגה שעלה בתחלת המחשבה, בחינת הנהגת הצדיקים הגבוהים הנ"ל ועל כן מי שרוצה לקרב את עצמו להשם יתברך, להמשיך על עצמו תוספת קדושה, צריך להניח תפלין דרבנו תם גם כן, כי כל ההתרחקות מהשם יתברך נמשך מהיצר הרע, ששרשו ממדת הדין, שנמשך מתחלת הצמצום של חלל הפנוי, ועל כן עקר תוספת קדושה נמשך על האדם על ידי תפלין דרבנו תם, שנמשכין מבחינת הצדיקים הנ"ל, העולים לבחינת שרש הדין וממתיקין הכל בשרשם, שעל ידי זה נמשך כח על כל הרחוקים לשבר ולבטל היצר הרע שנמשך משם. (שם, הלכה ה', אות כז כח):
segments.en:
2.
Our Sages of blessed memory said: "Every single day a person's yetzer hara overpowers him — and were it not for the Holy One, blessed be He, helping him — he could not prevail against it" . "Every single day the yetzer hara overpowers him" — this derives from the aspect of: "At first the thought arose to create the world with the attribute of strict judgment [midas hadin]". For this judgment arouses itself every single day — and wishes, G-d forbid, to conduct the world in this aspect. And from there the yetzer hara is aroused and intensifies — drawing from there every single day. For the essential yetzer hara and sitra achra derives from the aspect of judgments — drawn from the beginning of the contraction of the vacated space [chalal hapanui]. But G-d, blessed be He, immediately has compassion and precedes the attribute of mercy before the attribute of judgment — as our Sages of blessed memory said: "He saw that the world could not endure [through judgment alone], etc." Which is the aspect of the help and assistance He provides the person every single day to shatter the yetzer hara — which is from the attribute of judgment. And this is the aspect of the tefillin of Rashi — where the kindnesses [chassadim] precede the strengths [gevuros]. And this is the aspect of: "He preceded the attribute of mercy and paired it with the attribute of judgment" — which is the essential governance and sustaining of the entire world. And therefore the essential tefillin that everyone wears are those of Rashi — for this is the essential governance and sustaining of the world through this aspect.

But there are Tzaddikim who are so great that they need no assistance from Above. And G-d, blessed be He, conducts Himself with them as in the original thought — that is, through the attribute of strict judgment. And they stand firm through all the trials and sufferings and afflictions that derive from the attribute of judgment aforementioned. And they remain standing. And they sweeten the judgment at its very root — at the original thought. For they believe and know that the judgments and the sufferings themselves are great goodnesses. And through this they truly merit to ascend and be encompassed in the original thought — which is the aspect of: "Thus arose in thought" [kach alah b'machshavah] — said regarding the death of Rabbi Akiva. And this is the aspect of the tefillin of Rabbainu Tam — which are the aspect of the highest expanded consciousness [moichin govohim biyas]. And there the strengths precede the kindnesses. Which is the aspect of the governance that arose in the original thought — the aspect of the governance of the high Tzaddikim aforementioned.

And therefore one who wishes to draw close to G-d, blessed be He — to draw upon himself additional holiness — must also lay the tefillin of Rabbainu Tam. For all the distancing from G-d, blessed be He, derives from the yetzer hara — whose root is from the attribute of judgment — drawn from the beginning of the contraction of the vacated space. And therefore the essential additional holiness is drawn upon a person through the tefillin of Rabbainu Tam — which are drawn from the aspect of the Tzaddikim aforementioned who ascend to the root of the judgment and sweeten everything at their root. Through which the power is drawn upon all the distant ones — to shatter and nullify the yetzer hara that is drawn from there.

(ibid., Halacha 5, items 27–28).

history.en: This repair that the Tzadik — in the aspect of Moshe — engages in: to elevate from forced apostasy [shmad] to will [ratzon] — this is also needed by every single person according to his level. For even the upright — when they sometimes turn away from G-d — this is considered idol worship [avodah zarah] in the aspect of shmad, G-d protect us. As our Sages of blessed memory said regarding: "And you will turn away and serve other gods" [Deuteronomy 11:16]. And the essential aspect of idolatry and shmad is the desire for money and the entanglement and bitterness of livelihood. For the adversary and the baal davar brings down each person's mind to naturalism [tiv'iyus] — and wishes to distance him from faith in Providence and the Supreme Will. And because of this one always worries about money and livelihood. And there are those who have much money and desire more and more. And all of this is the aspect of shmad. For all idol worship is embedded in money, as explained elsewhere.

segments.he:
ג.
עכשו, בעקבות משיחא, בסוף הגלות, שהגלות והבעל דבר והסטרא אחרא מתגברין מאד, והעקר מה שמתגבר ומתפשט מאד האפיקורסות בעולם, וכל ההתגברות הזה הוא בחינת חבלי לדה, חבלי משיח, שכל זה נמשך משרש הדין של בחינת חלל הפנוי הנ"ל, ועל כן אין כח לעמד עכשו כנגדם, כי אם בכח הצדיקים הגדולים מאד הנ"ל, שיכולין לכנס לשם, לתוך בחינת חלל הפנוי, ולהמתיק הדין בשרשו, שעל ידי זה נתבטל כל כח היצר הרע של כל באי עולם שנמשך משם. על כן צריך כל אחד לזהר להניח תפלין דרבנו תם, שהם נמשכין מבחינת מחין הגבוהים של הצדיקים הנ"ל, כדי לקבל כח מהם לשבר את היצר הרע, שהתגבר עכשו מאד, שנמשך משם. (שם, אות כט):
segments.en:
3.
Now — in the footsteps of the Mashiach, at the end of the exile — when the exile and the baal davar and the sitra achra intensify greatly — and the essential [intensification] is that heresy [apikorsus] has spread and is spreading greatly in the world — all of this intensification is the aspect of the birth-pangs [chevlei leida] — the birth-pangs of the Mashiach. For all of this derives from the root of the judgment of the aspect of the vacated space aforementioned. And therefore there is now no power to stand against them — except through the power of the very great Tzaddikim aforementioned: who can enter there — into the aspect of the vacated space — and sweeten the judgment at its very root. Through which the entire power of the yetzer hara of all who come into the world — drawn from there — is nullified. Therefore every person must be careful to lay the tefillin of Rabbainu Tam — which are drawn from the aspect of the high expanded consciousness of those Tzaddikim aforementioned. In order to receive power from them — to shatter the yetzer hara that has now greatly intensified — drawn from there.

(ibid., item 29).

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: And the repair for this is to bind oneself to the truly righteous Tzaddikim of the generation — in the aspect of Moshe — and to multiply in holy tzedakah for the sake of Heaven, and not to be boastful, G-d forbid. And through this the illumination of the will is drawn from the aspect of Moshe who has departed — and is encompassed in the root of the will — ra'ava d'ra'avin [the will of all wills]. Until through this the holy will shines upon them in every kind of darkness to elevate them from there — [from there] — so that through this they ascend from shmad to ratzon.

segments.he: ערך תוכחה
segments.en: Rebuke

origin.notice: Editorial English rendering of the supplied Hebrew heading or closing text.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: Every person well knows — how many and how many times pass over him — spiritually and physically — in body and soul and money, etc. And how many and how many wondrous salvations G-d helps him each and every time. Especially in the matter of the holiness of his Judaism — which is the essential thing. And at every time and every time that passes over a person — whether in good or in hardship, whether in ascent or in descent — through all of them the Tzadik illuminates, so that Israel know what counsels to take and by what to keep themselves alive at every time — each according to the time that passes over him. In a manner that they will remain standing and will never fall or be distanced.

segments.he:
א.
לפעמים כשאדם מוכיח את עצמו או את חברו ומתחיל להזכיר המעשים רעים שעשה, אזי שכיח שיפל עוד יותר ויותר, כי נופל בדעתו מאד, ויש שנפלו מאד על ידי זה וכל זה נמשך מבחינת התוכחה שאינה כראוי, שמחלשת כח הנשמה על ידי שמעוררין הריח רע של עוונות, כי עקר התוכחה צריכה להיות בבחינת מטה כלפי חסד, לחפש למצא בעצמו וכן בחברו על כל פנים איזה נקודות טובות, והתוכחה תהיה בדרך חסד לחזק את עצמו ואת חברו בהשם יתברך ולבטח ברחמיו העצומים, שיש אצלו חסד כזה, שגם כל המעשים רעים יכולין להתהפך לזכויות, אפלו אם הרבה לפשע מאד, חס ושלום, כי עם השם החסד והרבה עמו פדות וכו', ועקר התוכחה תהיה באפן שיחזק את עצמו ואת חברו להתעורר להשם יתברך ולהתחיל מעתה להתקרב אליו יתברך, ולא שיקלקל יותר על ידי תוכחתו, שיפל חס ושלום יותר ולתוכחה כזאת אין זוכין כי אם על ידי שמקשרין עצמו לצדיקי הדור, שהם בחינת משה, שעל ידי תוכחתם מוסיפים ונותנים ריח טוב בהנשמות. הלכות ציצית, הלכה ה', אות ז):
segments.en:
1.
Sometimes when a person rebukes himself or his fellow and begins to recall the evil deeds that were done — it is common for him to fall even more and more. For he falls greatly in his mind. And there are those who have fallen greatly through this. And all of this derives from the aspect of rebuke that is not as it should be — which weakens the power of the soul through arousing the foul odor of sins. For the essential rebuke must be in the aspect of tilting toward kindness [mateh k'lapei chesed]: to seek and to find in oneself — and likewise in one's fellow — at the very least some good points. And the rebuke should be in the manner of kindness — to strengthen oneself and one's fellow in G-d (blessed be He) — and to trust in His immense compassion. For He has such kindness — that even all the evil deeds can be transformed into merits. Even if one has greatly multiplied transgression, G-d forbid. For "with G-d is kindness, and with Him is abundant redemption, etc." And the essential rebuke should be in a manner that one strengthens himself and his fellow to awaken toward G-d (blessed be He) — and to begin to draw close to Him (blessed be He) from now on. And not that through his rebuke he causes even more ruin — that the person falls even more, G-d forbid. And for such rebuke one can only merit through binding oneself to the Tzaddikim of the generation — who are the aspect of Moshe. Through whose rebuke [the rebuke of such Tzaddikim] they add and bestow a good fragrance upon the souls.

(Hilchos Tzitzis, Halacha 5, item 7).

origin.notice: English based on the supplied translation witness, incorporating source-bound corrections where needed.

history.label: Earlier site English (historical comparison, not the current translation).
history.en: And the essential [means] is: through binding all the times that pass over them to the last time — which is the time of receiving the reward of every person of Israel. At that time every person will merit according to his service the illumination of an overflowing will toward G-d — with a wondrous and awesome yearning. Which is the aspect of: "As now it will be said of Yaakov and of Israel: what has G-d wrought?" [Numbers 23:23] — as explained in the inner teachings. And to this time one must bind all the times that pass over him in this world. For the essential strengthening is through the will [ratzon] — that however things are and whatever passes over him — at the very least he should strengthen himself with a strong will toward G-d. For the good will in itself is very precious and important. And through this he will be awakened and will strengthen himself to always pray to G-d and to multiply the recitation of Psalms and supplications and many requests and hisbodidus — to pour out his heart like water before G-d — until G-d looks down from Heaven and sees — and shines upon him the true holy da'as to nullify the spirit of folly and to return from all sins and to draw close to G-d.

segments.he:
ב.
עקר החיוב לדבר עם חברו ביראת שמים ולהאיר בו הדעת האמתי הוא רק בשביל להרחיב דעתו של חברו, כי העקר - להוציא את עצמו ואת חברו מבחינת מחין דקטנות לבחינת מחין דגדלות, הינו להשתדל שיתגדל ויתרחב הדעת ביותר בכל פעם, שזה בחינת הרחבת גבול ארץ ישראל, בחינת: והרחבתי את גבולך, על כן כל אחד העוסק בזה לדבר עם חברו מהדעת הקדוש האמת, ובכל פעם צריך לזהר לעסק סיג לדבריו ולשתק במקום שצריכין לשתק, בכדי שלא להרס את הגבול של חברו לגמרי, שזה בחינת אסור הסגת הגבול, שלא די שאינו משתדל להרחיב גבולו של חברו, אף גם הוא מצר לו ביותר ונכנס בתוך גבולו, כי כל אחד מישראל יש לו גבול בפני עצמו בדעתו להשיג ולהבין עד הגבול דיקא בבחינת: ועלית אתה ואהרן וכו', ודרשו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה: אתה מחצה לעצמך ואהרן מחצה לעצמו וכו', ועל כן אף על פי שבודאי מצוה גדולה לדבר עם חברו בכל פעם ביראת שמים ולרחם עליו ולהוציאו מעוונות וקלקולים שלו, אוף על פי כן צריכין לזהר מאד, שיהיה העסק לטובה ולא לרעה, לתקן ולא לקלקל יותר, חס ושלום, שלא להסתכל ביותר בגנותו של חברו ובחסרונותיו, כי רב הקטטות והמריבות ושנאת חנם נמשך רק מזה, מה שכל אחד מסתכל שלא בעין יפה בחברו ומחפש למצא בו רק הפגמים ומדות רעות, עד שנדמה לו, שאי אפשר לסבלם, וממילא כמו כן מסתכל בו חברו גם כן להפך, כי כמים הפנים לפנים וכו', עד שנתעורר שנאת חנם וקטטות ביניהם, עד שעל ידי זה נחרב נחרב בית מקדשנו ונתארך עלינו הגלות, והכל רק על יד על ידי שנאת חנם, כמו שאמרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה, שכל זה בא רק על ידי זה שמסתכל ביותר בחברו, כי באמת צריכין לדון את כל אדם לכף זכות, כי אף על פי שבודאי צריכין לדבר עמו ולהאיר דעתו ולהוציאו ממה שצריכין להוציאו, שכל זה הוא בחינת דין ומשפט, כמבאר בפנים, אבל צריכין שיתגבר הרחמנות לכנס עם חברו לפנים משורת הדין, לבלי להסתכל בו לרעה כי אם לטובה לטובה ולדונו לכף זכות תמיד, שיוכל לדבר עמו, וכמבאר במקום אחר, שזה בחינת מצות ועשית הישר והטוב, שמזה למדו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה לעשות לפנים משורת הדין, וגם למדו מזה דין בן המצר, שהוא בחינת המצוה להשתדל ולהרחיב את גבול חברו, ושניהם - אחד. (הלכות שותפין בקרקע, הלכה ה', אות יד טז):
segments.en:
2.
The essential obligation to speak with one's fellow in fear of Heaven — and to illuminate within him the true divine knowledge — is only for the sake of broadening one's fellow's mind. For the essential [goal] is to bring out oneself and one's fellow from the aspect of moichin d'katnus [smallness of mind] to the aspect of moichin d'gadlus [greatness of mind]. That is, to strive that the mind should grow and expand more and more every single time. Which is the aspect of the broadening of the boundary of the Land of Israel — the aspect of: "And I will enlarge your boundary". And therefore each person who engages in this — to speak with his fellow about the true holy knowledge — must every single time be careful to make a boundary [seyag] for his words and to be silent where one must be silent. So as not to demolish one's fellow's boundary entirely. For this is the aspect of the prohibition of encroachment [hasogos gevul]. For not only does he not strive to broaden his fellow's boundary — but he also oppresses him more and enters into his boundary. For every single person of Israel has a boundary for himself in his own mind — to attain and understand up to that very boundary — in the aspect of: "And you shall ascend — you and Aharon, etc." — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "you in a partition of your own and Aharon in a partition of his own, etc."

And therefore even though certainly it is a great commandment to speak with one's fellow every single time in fear of Heaven — and to have compassion upon him and to bring him out from his sins and corruptions — even so, one must be very careful that the engagement be for the good and not for harm — to repair and not to cause more ruin, G-d forbid. Not to look too much at one's fellow's disgrace and his deficiencies. For most of the quarrels and disputes and causeless hatred derive only from this: that each person looks at his fellow not with a favorable eye — and seeks to find in him only the blemishes and evil character traits — until it seems to him that it is impossible to bear them. And naturally likewise his fellow also looks at him in the same reverse manner — for "as water reflects the face, etc.". Until causeless hatred and quarrels are stirred between them. Until through this our Temple was destroyed — [was destroyed] — and the exile was prolonged over us. And all of it only on account of — [on account of] — causeless hatred. As our Sages of blessed memory said. And all of this comes only from looking too much at one's fellow.

For in truth one must judge every person to the scale of merit. For even though certainly one must speak with him and illuminate his mind and bring him out from what he needs to be brought out from — and all of this is the aspect of judgment and law [din u'mishpot] — as explained in the inner teachings — even so, one must overpower oneself with compassion to enter with one's fellow beyond the letter of the law [lifnim mishuras hadin]. Not to look at him for bad — only for good — [for good] — and to judge him to the scale of merit always. So that one can speak with him. And as is explained elsewhere — that this is the aspect of the commandment: "And you shall do what is right and good". From which our Sages of blessed memory derived [the obligation] to go beyond the letter of the law. And they also derived from this the law of bar metzra [the neighbor's right of first refusal] — which is the aspect of the commandment to strive to broaden one's fellow's boundary. And both are one.

(Hilchos Shutfim B'Karaka, Halacha 5, items 14, 16).
